request.query: Find US companies hiring for staff or senior backend engineer roles (remote or Denver, Colorado area) that use Greenhouse, Lever, or Ashby as their applicant tracking system AND are documented to sponsor US work visas (H-1B). Only return companies where you can identify the company's OWN job board base URL on one of these three platforms (e.g. https://boards.greenhouse.io/<company>, https://jobs.lever.co/<company>, or https://jobs.ashbyhq.com/<company> -- the board root, not a link to a specific job posting or a third-party aggregator like LinkedIn, Indeed, or another job site). Skip a company if you cannot find its own board URL on one of those three ATS platforms. For each company give: the company name, the exact board URL, the ATS provider, and visa sponsorship evidence with a source URL (an H-1B filing record, careers page, or job posting). Exclude: Coupang, ClickHouse, Gen Digital.

citations.title: Staff Software Engineer, FinPlatform Backend at Flex - United States Remote
Senior Backend Engineer - Backend Platform (USA Only, 100% Remote) at Close
Senior Backend Engineer – Backend Platform at Close - United States Remote

companies.sponsorship_evidence: A public job listing labels Flex “H1B Visa Sponsor” and states: “This company has sponsored H1B visas in the past.” The company’s Greenhouse board lists “Staff Software Engineer, Backend, Money Team” as Remote.

A public job listing labels Close “H1B Visa Sponsor” and states: “This company has sponsored H1B visas in the past.” Close’s Ashby posting is “Senior Backend Engineer - Backend Platform (USA Only, 100% Remote)” and says the role is open at Senior and Staff levels.

output.text: Two companies matched the requested ATS-board, remote backend-role, and documented H-1B-sponsorship criteria. The excluded companies were not included.
